title: Average hitting times and recurrence structures II: Cartesian products of powers of cycles and regular graphs
summary: In our previous work \cite{MiezakiTamura2026}, we clarified the second-order linear recurrence structures appearing in the average hitting times on the $k$-th power graph $C_N^k$ of the cycle graph. In this paper, for a connected $r$-regular graph $G$ on $m$ vertices, we investigate the average hitting times of the simple random walk on the Cartesian product graph $C_N^k \square G$.
